items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: I think Rodgers. I know him.

ctx.x: I think he got some fellas way back there, man.
Oh, Al Landry and Ernest Rogers, I think he worked with them. Some.
I know Landry. Big old red. I think Rodgers. I know him. Big old Landry. Yeah. Did you ever work with Landry?
